title: Bleach’s Final Season Finally Returns With English Dub (New Release Schedule Revealed)
content: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War is now back in action with its final season of episodes this Summer , and the English dub release of this final season has finally kicked off a new schedule of releases with Hulu.
author: ComicBook

title: One Piece’s Live-Action Zoro Teases Future of The Netflix Series: “I’m Going to be 85”
content: Mackenyu has been an old hat when it comes to taking part in live-action anime adaptations. In his acting career, the young actor has been a part of adaptations such as Knights of the Zodiac, Fullmetal Alchemist, Tokyo Ghoul S, JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure, Rurouni Kenshin , and more.
author: ComicBook

title: Youka Nitta to Publish More Embracing Love Manga in Spring 2027
content: Nitta stated they do not know how much more they will draw for the series, but stated they will do their best "until they are dried out." They also thanked readers for their passionate requests and suggestions about drawing moments that take place during breaks in the main story.
author: ANN

title: BLEACH: TYBW Part 4 Features Uryu Ishida Changes in Episode 6 Ending Video
content: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War (TYBW) Part 4 The Calamity premiered Episode 6 “THE END” on August 29 with new changes to its ending video. While the majority of the video is unchanged, there are several frames that now feature Uryu Ishida.
author: Anime Corner

title: Arcanadea Anime Reveals Teaser Trailer, January 2027 Release Date
content: ARCANADEA anime revealed its first teaser trailer, along with a January 2027 release date. The anime is based on Kotobukiya’s Arcanadea plastic model series, which launched in December 2021 with an “SF x Fantasy” concept and original character designs by necömi.
author: Anime Corner

title: Comic, Manga Letterer Dave Lanphear Dies at 58
content: Dave's sister Tera Lanphear first shared the news on Facebook on August 22. Lanphear was an award-winning cartoonist, comic book and manga letterer, art director, and story producer. He was born on June 5, 1968 and worked as a newspaper illustrator from 1985 to 1989.
author: ANN

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 New Teaser Visual Reminds Us of Sukuna's "Something Interesting" Line
content: JUJUTSU KAISEN Season 4 , Culling Game Arc Part 2, revealed the first anime super teaser visual during the Juju Fes 2026 event in Japan. The visual was revealed along with Sukuna’s line, “Do you remember? I told you that you’d get to see something interesting.” You can see the new below.
author: Anime Corner

title: Arcanadea TV Anime Reveals More Cast, January 2027 Debut in Video
content: The staff for the television anime of Kotobukiya 's Arcanadea bishōjo plastic model series revealed a teaser promotional video, main staff, more cast, and January 2027 debut on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: Bleach Mirrors High Mobile Game Streams 2 New Short Videos
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment revealed two new short videos for the Bleach Mirrors High mobile game on Saturday. The trailers announce that pre-registrations for the game are now open . The game is scheduled for release in 2026.
author: ANN

title: 'Arcanadea' Reveals Main Staff, Additional Cast, Second Teaser Promo for Winter 2027
content: The Arcanadea Engage Fest 2026 event revealed the main staff, four additional cast members, and a second teaser promotional video for the television anime adaptation of Arcanadea model series on Saturday. The anime series will premiere in January 2027 on TV Asahi's NUMAnimation programming block and BS Asahi.
author: MyAnimeList
